stemMd: An isolated mitochondrion has fuel and oxygen. A substance makes its inner membrane freely permeable to protons without directly blocking electron transfer. Which immediate effect is expected?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Conversion of ATP synthase into DNA polymerase

options.label: B
options.textMd: A larger proton gradient despite the leak

options.label: C
options.textMd: ATP production without any energy source

options.label: D
options.textMd: Complete cessation of all electron movement necessarily

options.label: E
options.textMd: Reduced ATP production by ATP synthase as the proton gradient dissipates

explanationMd: ATP synthase depends on a proton electrochemical gradient. A leak allows protons to return without passing productively through the enzyme, uncoupling electron transport from ATP production.

distractorRationale.c: The proton-motive force supplies energy for this synthesis.
distractorRationale.d: A proton leak does not itself block electron transfer.
distractorRationale.a: Enzyme identity does not change this way.
